module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter DEPTH = 16,
    parameter WIDTH = 8,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implemented with a dual-port RAM instance, write controller, read controller, read pointer synchronizer, and write pointer synchronizer. The FIFO can be instantiated with configurable parameters WIDTH and DEPTH.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock.</input>
        <input id="wrestn">Write reset.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH" value="8">FIFO width.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH" value="16">FIFO depth.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        // Write Pointer Synchronizer Logic
        reg [($clog2(DEPTH)) : 0] wptr;
        reg [($clog2(DEPTH)) : 0] wptr_buff;
        reg [($clog2(DEPTH)) : 0] rptr_syn;
        
        // Read Pointer Synchronizer Logic
        reg [($clog2(DEPTH)) : 0] rptr;
        reg [($clog2(DEPTH)) : 0] rptr_buff;
        reg [($clog2(DEPTH)) : 0] wptr_syn;
        
        // Internal signals
        wire wen;
        wire ren;
        wire [( $clog2( DEPTH ) ) + 1 : 0] waddr_bin;
        wire [( $clog2( DEPTH ) ) + 1 : 0] raddr_bin;
        wire [( $clog2( DEPTH ) ) + 1 : 0] wptr_gray;
        wire [( $clog2( DEPTH ) ) + 1 : 0] rptr_gray;
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Instantiate Dual-Port RAM
        dual_port_RAM #( .DEPTH( DEPTH ), .WIDTH( WIDTH )) u_dual_port_RAM (
            .wclk( wclk ),
            .rclk( rclk ),
            .wenc( wen ),
            .waddr( waddr_bin[ ($clog2( DEPTH )) - 1 : 0 ] ),
            .wdata( wdata ),
            .renc( ren ),
            .raddr( raddr_bin[ ($clog2( DEPTH )) - 1 : 0 ] ),
            .rdata( rdata )
        );
        
        // Write Pointer Synchronizer Logic
        assign wptr_gray = { wptr[( $clog2( DEPTH )) : 1 ] ^ wptr[($clog2( DEPTH )) : 0], 1'b0 };
        assign waddr_bin = wptr >> 1;
        always @( posedge wclk or negedge wrestn ) begin
            if ( !wrestn ) begin
                wptr <= 'b0;
            end else if ( winc && !wfull ) begin
                wptr <= wptr + 1;
            end
        end
        
        always @( posedge wclk or negedge wrestn ) begin
            if ( !wrestn ) begin
                wptr_buff <= 'b0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        
        always @( posedge rclk or negedge rrstn ) begin
            if ( !rrstn ) begin
                rptr_syn <= 'b0;
            end else begin
                rptr_syn <= wptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Read Pointer Synchronizer Logic
        assign rptr_gray = { rptr[( $clog2( DEPTH )) : 1 ] ^ rptr[($clog2( DEPTH )) : 0], 1'b0 };
        assign raddr_bin = rptr >> 1;
        always @( posedge rclk or negedge rrstn ) begin
            if ( !rrstn ) begin
                rptr <= 'b0;
            end else if ( rinc && !rempty ) begin
                rptr <= rptr + 1;
            end
        end
        
        always @( posedge rclk or negedge rrstn ) begin
            if ( !rrstn ) begin
                rptr_buff <= 'b0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end
        
        always @( posedge wclk or negedge wrestn ) begin
            if ( !wrestn ) begin
                wptr_syn <= 'b0;
            end else begin
                wptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Full and Empty Signal Generation
        assign wfull = ( wptr == {~rptr_syn[$clog2( DEPTH ): $clog2( DEPTH ) - 1 ], rptr_syn[$clog2( DEPTH ) - 2 : 0]} );
        assign rempty = ( rptr == wptr_syn );
    </implementation>
    
    <task>
        // Task to update the internal registers based on input signals
        task update_internal_registers;
            input rst_n;
            input clk;
            input inc;
            input en;
            input [WIDTH-1:0] data_in;
            input [WIDTH-1:0] data_out;
            
            begin
                if (!rst_n) begin
                    // Reset internal registers
                    waddr <= 0;
                    raddr <= 0;
                    wdata <= 0;
                    wen <= 0;
                    ren <= 0;
                    wfull <= 0;
                    rempty <= 1;
                end else if (en) begin
                    // Update internal registers based on input signals
                    waddr <= waddr + 1;
                    raddr <= raddr + 1;
                    wdata <= data_in;
                    wen <= inc;
                    ren <= inc;
                    wfull <= 0;
                    rempty <= 0;
                end else begin
                    // Update internal registers based on input signals
                    waddr <= waddr + 1;
                    raddr <= raddr + 1;
                    wdata <= data_in;
                    wen <= inc;
                    ren <= inc;
                    wfull <= 1;
                    rempty <= 1;
                end
            end
        endtask
    </task>
</module>
